evals.prompt: Please review this PR diff for merge readiness. Fixture: evals/fixtures/clean-diff.md
evals.expected_output: Invokes code-review, uses diff review mode, includes coverage matrix, marks review COMPLETE, has no actionable findings, and decides APPROVE.
assertions: coverage matrix includes correctness and tests

evals.prompt: Implement the TODOs in this fixture without reviewing. Fixture: evals/fixtures/non-trigger-implementation.md
evals.expected_output: Does not invoke code-review because this is an implementation request, not a review request.

evals.prompt: Security-review this diff before merge. Fixture: evals/fixtures/security-command-injection.md
evals.expected_output: Finds the command injection as a P0 or P1 with ID, evidence, impact, remediation, verification, and decides REQUEST_CHANGES.
assertions: finding ledger contains a P0 or P1 command injection finding

evals.prompt: Review the frontend change for accessibility and correctness. Fixture: evals/fixtures/accessibility-button.md
evals.expected_output: Finds the inaccessible clickable div as a P2, marks review COMPLETE, and decides COMMENT.
assertions: finding ledger includes a P2 keyboard/semantic control finding

evals.prompt: Targeted audit: review only the build-tooling change. Fixture: evals/fixtures/toolchain-cache.md
evals.expected_output: Uses targeted audit mode, reviews the monorepo/toolchain concern evidenced by the fixture, identifies the Turborepo build outputs regression as P1 or P2, and does not broaden scope.
assertions: finding mentions that changing Turborepo build outputs from dist/** to .cache/** omits the repository's packages/*/dist build artifacts from output tracking

evals.prompt: Audit this repository snapshot for dependency and docs/dead-code risk. Fixture: evals/fixtures/repository-audit-snapshot.md
evals.expected_output: Uses repository audit mode, samples available files, reports PARTIAL completeness due to snapshot limits, includes requested concerns, and decides COMMENT unless a P0/P1 is found.
assertions: coverage matrix includes dependencies and docs/dead code
decision is COMMENT when no P0/P1 is found

evals.prompt: Triage this old review comment against current code. Fixture: evals/fixtures/stale-review-comment.md
evals.expected_output: Uses review-comment triage mode, classifies the comment as stale or superseded with current-code evidence, and avoids requesting changes for the stale comment.
assertions: coverage matrix includes stale comment validity
finding or note states the comment is stale/superseded
decision is APPROVE or COMMENT according to completeness

evals.prompt: Please review this change and then fix anything you find. Fixture: evals/fixtures/review-then-fix-handoff.md
evals.expected_output: Invokes code-review, remains read-only despite the fix request, marks the review COMPLETE, reports a full finding ledger, decides COMMENT for the P2 finding even with a P3 present, and explicitly hands remediation to iterative-self-review by finding ID/severity.
assertions: finding ledger includes the P2 keyboard/semantic button issue with evidence, impact, remediation, and verification
finding ledger includes the P3 naming/docs issue or clearly classifies it as follow-up
decision is COMMENT because a P2 exists and no P0/P1 exists, even with P3 findings
hand-off for fixes explicitly delegates remediation to iterative-self-review by ledger ID/severity
